name: Joseph Goodwill
source:
Only son of the illustrious Robert Goodwill.
Surprisingly, his character is the opposite of his father. Very arrogant and sure of himself, he seems involved in various dubious businesses.
He loves to flirt with any woman that sparks his interest, but remains quite selective.
